name: Warden of the Lost cuts Spectral Warden's cooldown on summon damage (#683)
contract: Warden of the Lost 707116 promises: damage dealt by Spectral Scythes and Spectral Wardens reduces
Spectral Warden's cooldown by 500 ms. Effect 0 is SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_APPLY_AURA_TO_SUMMONS(190),
delivering a native SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL(42) to the Reaper's owned summons that triggers
targets 805716 with -500 ms). Spell.dbc carries ProcFlags=0 for 707116, so without a spell_proc row
the applied aura never saw a damage event. The Spectral Warden guardian (100481) is itself a valid
target of the aura, so casting 805716 and letting the guardian fight is enough to exercise it.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Spectral Warden is on its full cooldown
The Reaper is engaged, drawing the guardian into the fight
Let the guardian land several melee swings
Cooldown dropped by more than the 20 s that elapsed, proving Warden of the Lost fired at least once
